topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I can hardly believe my eyes when I spot it tucked away in the corner, almost like it's hiding. That old, familiar patch of threadbare fur, the glassy button eyes that have seen too much. It's him, my teddy, the one I thought was gone forever, lost in the attic of a house we moved from years ago. The house isn't mine anymore, and neither is the tedty, yet here he is, for sale at a stranger's yard sale. I hesitate, my hands feel cold as I reach out to touch him. What if he remembers the secrets we shared, the silent promises of a child? I tuck him into my jacket, and the world outside seems a bit dimmer, a bit less safe.
